title: Amina and the Little Hen
blurb: Amina's little hen is gone! Can you help her look?

chapters.title: Where Is Pepe?
chapters.text:
Amina has a little brown hen. The hen is called Pepe. Every morning Pepe says, "Cluck, cluck!"

Today Amina calls, "Pepe! Pepe!" But there is no cluck. The hen is not in the yard. The hen is not in the house.

"Oh no," says Amina. "Where is Pepe?"

questions.why: Amina has a little brown hen.

questions.prompt: What does Pepe say every morning?

questions.why: Amina calls, but there is no cluck.

In the yard and in the house
questions.why: The hen is not in the yard and not in the house, so Amina looked there.

questions.prompt: What does Amina say at the end?
questions.why: Amina says, "Oh no! Where is Pepe?"

chapters.title: Looking and Looking
chapters.text:
Amina looks by the big tree. No Pepe. She looks by the red gate. No Pepe.

A boy called Juma sees Amina. "Why are you sad?" he asks.

"My hen is gone," says Amina.

"I will help you," says Juma. They look and look. Then they hear a tiny sound. "Peep, peep!"

chapters.title: Pepe's Surprise
chapters.text:
Amina and Juma follow the sound. It comes from behind a box. Amina looks. There is Pepe!

Pepe is sitting on a nest. Under her there are four tiny yellow chicks. "Peep, peep!" say the chicks.

Amina laughs. "Pepe, you are a mama now!" Amina and Juma give the chicks some seeds. Everyone is happy.
